mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CHAT_MESSAGE(CHAT_ID, NUM, TYPE, CONTENT, ROLE) VALUES (#{chatId}, #{num}, #{type}, #{content}, #{role})
INSERT INTO T_CHAT_MESSAGE(CHAT_ID, NUM, TYPE, CONTENT, ROLE) VALUES (#{chatId}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(M.NUM), 0) + 1 FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.CHAT_ID = #{chatId}), #{type}, #{content}, #{role})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_ID = #{chatId} AND NUM = #{num}
